title: DepKeeper - Python Dependency Updater
description: A CLI that upgrades requirements.txt without crossing a major version boundary. It computes a safe target for each requirement, cross-checks them against each other, then rewrites the file in place, keeping the upper bounds and exclusions you wrote. Every change previews as a dry run first, and re-running it is idempotent. On PyPI under Apache 2.0, for Python 3.8 to 3.12.

title: Now Boarding Scheduler - Board Game Session Planner
description: A weekly session scheduler for a board game cafe in Bengaluru. It takes four poll CSVs covering game preferences, availability and which venue people can reach, and returns a timetable where nobody is double-booked and no physical copy of a game runs twice in the same slot. Session selection is a mixed-integer program, solved to a proven optimum with SciPy's HiGHS backend (no heuristic shortcuts), run as six lexicographic passes: once a higher priority is settled, no lower pass can undo it. Every scheduled session carries a plain-English reason it was picked.
